problem: The existing malformed-layer XDATA test expected both codecs to write repeated APPID groups. The current system codec rejects those groups, causing the focused layer selector to fail.
change: Retain the bundled-codec preservation expectation. For the system codec, assert refusal, preserve an existing destination, correct the duplicate APPID group, and retry through the same filter.
validation: The complete [filter][layer] selector passed 55 assertions in 4 cases with the system codec and 51 assertions in 4 cases with the bundled codec.
The corrected retry checks the surviving layer markers and unrelated APPID name.
The [filter][layer] system-codec selector also passed 55 assertions in 4 cases under AddressSanitizer, with leak detection disabled.
limitations: This is a test-contract correction, not a change to the codec policy or a claim of support for malformed XDATA.
